[P2] Preserve existing deprecation and upgrade warnings

The pruning removes entries that satisfy the new scope: the ESLint `configs.recommended` deprecation and the addition of `valid-operation-identifiers` to the recommended configuration, whose deleted entry explicitly warns that upgrading can make lint fail. Both remain implemented, but neither appears anywhere in the rewritten changelog. Readers lose the migration guidance this file promises. Restore these entries under their applicable release headings, or `[Unreleased]` if they have not shipped.
